status: Implemented locally and real routing verified; not deployed

customerExperience.location: Customer homepage Delivery section, shared by website templates
customerExperience.flow: Expand Estimate your delivery cost, enter a UK delivery postcode, choose Calculate delivery, review road mileage and the price breakdown.
customerExperience.formula: Base price + displayed one-way road miles × price per mile; calculated in integer pence, rounded to the nearest penny.
customerExperience.fallback: No straight-line mileage or guessed charge. Invalid postcode asks for correction; routing/missing coordinates/quota failure asks the customer to contact the dealership.
customerExperience.records: No enquiry, invoice, booking, payment or sale charge is created.

settings.defaults: Existing delivery text unchanged; calculator absent until explicitly enabled with valid prices.
settings.compatibility: Optional deliveryPricing object. Existing settings publications without that field preserve previously saved pricing. Existing revision and owner permission checks are retained.

routing.basis: One-way driving route from showroom postcode coordinates to customer postcode coordinates. Not straight-line or HGV routing.
routing.cache: Successful directional route distances cached in PostgreSQL and bounded process memory for seven-day layers; cached distance is independent of dealership prices. No automatic polling.
routing.limits: Four concurrent uncached routes per process. Conservative 40/minute and 2000/day shared database budget across instances/restarts, plus process counters; failed/partial reservations may conservatively consume budget. Provider quotas can still return unavailable.
routing.privacy: Only coordinate pairs sent upstream; no customer name, street address, phone, email or dealership ID. Keys never sent to the browser. Attribution shown alongside calculator.
routing.localConfiguration: Key saved in ignored local .env with permissions 0600; not printed, committed or copied to Render.

database.migration: 0073_delivery_road_distance.sql adds road_distance_cache and road_routing_usage; requires earlier 0072 postcode migration

verification.focusedUiFinal: 11 postcode/calculator tests passed after display and formatting refinement
verification.backendDelivery: 7 tests passed: money/rounding, provider format/caching, no fallback, durable cache, database quotas, tenant-isolated HTTP, settings schema compatibility
verification.regressions: 14 settings, 9 publication and 9 postcode service/HTTP/database tests passed
verification.responsiveBrowser: 3 passed at 390/820/1440px: save mock settings, calculate mock road quote, outage/no-free-quote, disable calculator; no real writes or external calls

nextStep: Deployment requires approval, private configuration of the routing key on Render, migrations 0072/0073 and a post-deployment check. None of these production actions has been performed.
